units.source_text: 深闺中诸女眷，隔院遥闻车马鼓乐喧嚣扰攘之声，

en.t: The women secluded deep within their chambers heard, from across the courtyards, the distant clamor of carriages, horses, drums, and music,

units.source_text: 似觉生在西方极乐世界的未开莲花中，心中好生焦灼！

en.t: and felt as though they had been born inside unopened lotus buds in the Western Paradise, their hearts unbearably restless!

units.source_text: 远居在二条院东院中诸人，更不必说。

en.t: Needless to say, it was even more so for those living far away in the eastern wing of the Nijo mansion.

units.source_text: 她们的孤寂虽然与年月俱增，但她们都怀着古歌中所谓“欲窜入深山，脱却世间苦”的心情，

en.t: Although their loneliness grew with the passing years, they all held in their hearts the feeling described in the old poem: to flee into the deep mountains and cast off the sorrows of the world,

units.source_text: 对于源氏这个薄幸郎，已经不再怨恨了。

en.t: and they no longer bore resentment toward Genji, that faithless man.

units.source_text: 除此以外，她们万事称心，一无遗憾。

en.t: Apart from that, everything suited them perfectly, and they had nothing to regret.

units.source_text: 爱好修行的人，例如尼姑空蝉，可以一心念佛，毫无牵挂；

en.t: Those who loved religious practice, such as the nun Utsusemi, could devote themselves entirely to chanting the Buddha's name, free of all cares;

units.source_text: 爱好诗歌学问的人，例如末摘花，可以埋头研习，随心所欲。

en.t: those who loved poetry and learning, such as Suetsumuhana, could bury themselves in study as much as they pleased.

units.source_text: 凡日常生活种种需要，都安排妥帖，应有尽有，无不如意称心。

en.t: Every need of daily life was properly arranged; everything they could require was provided, and all was to their satisfaction.

units.source_text: 新年忙乱的日子过去之后，源氏就来访问这二条院东院中的人。

en.t: After the busy days of the New Year had passed, Genji came to visit the people in the eastern wing of the Nijo mansion.
